sections.name: Gaucho Stu
sections.note: Pretty Much Argentinian. All our beef is grass fed farm shop beef, The proper stuff!

items.name: Devil's Broth Beef Stew
items.description: 8 hour cooked chunks of the best cut steak with potato in a rich gravy, served with crispy bread. *Add Chilli on request

items.name: The Ogre's Steak Sandwich
items.description: 24 hour marinated steak served in a baguette with lettuce, sundried tomato, garlic mayo and fresh homemade chimichurri

items.name: Steak Loaded Fries
items.description: 24 hour marinated steak served on crispy fries with garlic mayo and fresh homemade chimichurri

items.name: Dragon Firecracker Steak Loaded Fries
items.description: 24 hour marinated steak coated in firecracker sauce, served on crispy fries with melted cheese, garlic mayo and fresh homemade chimichurri

items.name: Steak & Pork Belly Loaded Fries
items.description: 24 hour marinated steak and salt & chilli pork belly, served on crispy fries with garlic mayo and fresh homemade chimichurri

items.name: The Wolves Ragu Loaded Fries
items.description: Homemade bolognese served on crispy fries and garnished with fresh chopped parsley

items.name: Mami's Smoky Bean Chilli Loaded Fries
items.description: Homemade smoky chilli, packed with protein and fibre, served on crispy fries and finished with fresh homemade chimichurri

items.name: Huge Family Platter
items.description: 24 hour marinated steak, salt & chilli pork belly, firecracker steak and homemade ragu served over crispy fries with garlic mayo and fresh homemade chimichurri
